import 'package:funkovault2/atlas/collection/models/atlas_collector_state.dart';
import 'package:funkovault2/models/pop.dart';

class AtlasCollectorStateEngine {
  const AtlasCollectorStateEngine();

  AtlasCollectorState evaluate({
    required Pop product,
    required List<Pop> collectionPops,
    String scannedBarcode = '',
    Set<String> ownedWishlistIdentityKeys =
    const <String>{},
  }) {
    final Set<String> scannedBarcodeCandidates =
    _barcodeCandidates(
      scannedBarcode,
    );

    final String productIdentityKey =
    product.collectibleIdentityKey.trim();

    final String productSimilarityKey =
    product.similarityReviewKey.trim();

    final List<Pop> ownedMatches = <Pop>[];
    final List<Pop> wishlistMatches = <Pop>[];
    final List<Pop> relatedMatches = <Pop>[];

    for (final Pop collectionPop in collectionPops) {
      final bool isExactMatch = _isExactMatch(
        product: product,
        collectionPop: collectionPop,
        productIdentityKey: productIdentityKey,
        scannedBarcodeCandidates:
        scannedBarcodeCandidates,
      );

      if (isExactMatch) {
        if (collectionPop.isWishlist) {
          wishlistMatches.add(
            collectionPop,
          );
        } else {
          ownedMatches.add(
            collectionPop,
          );
        }

        continue;
      }

      final String collectionSimilarityKey =
      collectionPop.similarityReviewKey.trim();

      final bool isRelatedMatch =
          productSimilarityKey.isNotEmpty &&
              collectionSimilarityKey.isNotEmpty &&
              collectionSimilarityKey ==
                  productSimilarityKey;

      if (isRelatedMatch) {
        relatedMatches.add(
          collectionPop,
        );
      }
    }

    final bool isProductIdentityWishlisted =
        productIdentityKey.isNotEmpty &&
            ownedWishlistIdentityKeys.contains(
              productIdentityKey,
            );

    final bool isOwnedMatchWishlisted =
    ownedMatches.any(
          (Pop ownedPop) {
        final String identityKey =
        ownedPop.collectibleIdentityKey.trim();

        return identityKey.isNotEmpty &&
            ownedWishlistIdentityKeys.contains(
              identityKey,
            );
      },
    );

    final bool isOwnedWishlisted =
        isProductIdentityWishlisted ||
            isOwnedMatchWishlisted;

    return AtlasCollectorState(
      ownedMatches: ownedMatches,
      wishlistMatches: wishlistMatches,
      relatedMatches: relatedMatches,
      isOwnedWishlisted: isOwnedWishlisted,
    );
  }

  List<Pop> findByBarcode({
    required String barcode,
    required List<Pop> collectionPops,
  }) {
    final Set<String> barcodeCandidates =
    _barcodeCandidates(
      barcode,
    );

    if (barcodeCandidates.isEmpty) {
      return const <Pop>[];
    }

    final List<Pop> matches = <Pop>[];

    for (final Pop pop in collectionPops) {
      final Set<String> popBarcodeCandidates =
      _barcodeCandidates(
        pop.sourceUpc,
      );

      final bool matchesBarcode =
          popBarcodeCandidates.isNotEmpty &&
              barcodeCandidates.any(
                popBarcodeCandidates.contains,
              );

      if (matchesBarcode) {
        matches.add(
          pop,
        );
      }
    }

    return List<Pop>.unmodifiable(
      matches,
    );
  }

  bool _isExactMatch({
    required Pop product,
    required Pop collectionPop,
    required String productIdentityKey,
    required Set<String> scannedBarcodeCandidates,
  }) {
    final String collectionIdentityKey =
    collectionPop.collectibleIdentityKey.trim();

    // Strongest release-level comparison.
    if (productIdentityKey.isNotEmpty &&
        collectionIdentityKey.isNotEmpty &&
        productIdentityKey == collectionIdentityKey) {
      return true;
    }

    final Set<String> collectionBarcodeCandidates =
    _barcodeCandidates(
      collectionPop.sourceUpc,
    );

    final bool isBarcodeMatch =
        scannedBarcodeCandidates.isNotEmpty &&
            collectionBarcodeCandidates.isNotEmpty &&
            scannedBarcodeCandidates.any(
              collectionBarcodeCandidates.contains,
            );

    if (isBarcodeMatch) {
      return true;
    }

    final String productRecordKey =
    product.collectionRecordKey.trim();

    final String collectionRecordKey =
    collectionPop.collectionRecordKey.trim();

    return productRecordKey.isNotEmpty &&
        collectionRecordKey.isNotEmpty &&
        productRecordKey == collectionRecordKey;
  }

  Set<String> _barcodeCandidates(
      String value,
      ) {
    final String normalizedBarcode =
    _normalizeBarcode(
      value,
    );

    if (normalizedBarcode.isEmpty) {
      return const <String>{};
    }

    final Set<String> candidates = <String>{
      normalizedBarcode,
    };

    if (normalizedBarcode.length == 13 &&
        normalizedBarcode.startsWith('0')) {
      candidates.add(
        normalizedBarcode.substring(1),
      );
    }

    if (normalizedBarcode.length == 12) {
      candidates.add(
        '0$normalizedBarcode',
      );
    }

    return candidates;
  }

  String _normalizeBarcode(
      String value,
      ) {
    return value.replaceAll(
      RegExp(r'[^0-9A-Za-z]'),
      '',
    );
  }
}

import 'package:funkovault2/atlas/catalog/models/atlas_catalog_product.dart';
import 'package:funkovault2/atlas/catalog/services/atlas_catalog_service.dart';
import 'package:funkovault2/atlas/completion/engine/atlas_completion_engine.dart';
import 'package:funkovault2/atlas/completion/models/atlas_completion_query.dart';
import 'package:funkovault2/atlas/completion/models/atlas_completion_result.dart';
import 'package:funkovault2/atlas/taxonomy/models/atlas_completion_scope.dart';
import 'package:funkovault2/atlas/taxonomy/models/atlas_taxonomy.dart';
import 'package:funkovault2/atlas/taxonomy/models/atlas_taxonomy_node.dart';
import 'package:funkovault2/atlas/taxonomy/services/atlas_taxonomy_service.dart';
import 'package:funkovault2/models/pop.dart';

final class AtlasCompletionService {
  AtlasCompletionService({
    AtlasCatalogService? catalogService,
    AtlasCompletionEngine? completionEngine,
    AtlasTaxonomyService? taxonomyService,
  })  : _catalogService =
      catalogService ?? AtlasCatalogService.instance,
        _completionEngine =
            completionEngine ?? AtlasCompletionEngine(),
        _taxonomyService =
            taxonomyService ?? AtlasTaxonomyService.instance;

  static final AtlasCompletionService instance =
  AtlasCompletionService();

  final AtlasCatalogService _catalogService;
  final AtlasCompletionEngine _completionEngine;
  final AtlasTaxonomyService _taxonomyService;

  /// Calculates completion for the selected product's variant family.
  ///
  /// Example:
  ///
  /// Ted DiBiase #41
  /// - Common
  /// - Chase
  /// - Exclusive
  /// - Other catalog releases sharing the same family
  Future<AtlasCompletionResult> evaluateVariantFamily({
    required AtlasCatalogProduct selectedProduct,
    required List<Pop> collectionPops,
    Set<String> ownedWishlistIdentityKeys =
    const <String>{},
    String collectionName = 'All Atlas Collections',
    bool includeWishlist = true,
    bool includeInactiveCatalogItems = false,
    int searchLimit = 250,
  }) async {
    final AtlasTaxonomy selectedTaxonomy =
    _taxonomyService.resolve(
      selectedProduct,
    );

    final AtlasTaxonomyNode? variantFamilyNode =
    selectedTaxonomy.nodeForScope(
      AtlasCompletionScope.variantFamily,
    );

    if (variantFamilyNode == null) {
      return _evaluateExactRelease(
        selectedProduct: selectedProduct,
        selectedTaxonomy: selectedTaxonomy,
        collectionPops: collectionPops,
        ownedWishlistIdentityKeys:
        ownedWishlistIdentityKeys,
        collectionName: collectionName,
        includeWishlist: includeWishlist,
        includeInactiveCatalogItems:
        includeInactiveCatalogItems,
      );
    }

    final List<AtlasCatalogProduct> candidates =
    await _findVariantFamilyCandidates(
      selectedProduct: selectedProduct,
      searchLimit: searchLimit,
    );

    final AtlasCompletionQuery query =
    AtlasCompletionQuery(
      filters: <AtlasCompletionFilter>[
        AtlasCompletionFilter(
          scope: AtlasCompletionScope.variantFamily,
          nodeId: variantFamilyNode.id,
          displayName: variantFamilyNode.name,
        ),
      ],
      primaryScope:
      AtlasCompletionScope.variantFamily,
      includeWishlist: includeWishlist,
      includeInactiveCatalogItems:
      includeInactiveCatalogItems,
    );

    return _completionEngine.evaluate(
      query: query,
      catalogProducts: candidates,
      collectionPops: collectionPops,
      ownedWishlistIdentityKeys:
      ownedWishlistIdentityKeys,
      collectionName: collectionName,
    );
  }

  /// Calculates completion for any taxonomy node already resolved by Atlas.
  ///
  /// This supports future experiences such as:
  ///
  /// - Character completion
  /// - Series completion
  /// - Franchise completion
  /// - Retailer-exclusive completion
  /// - Convention completion
  Future<AtlasCompletionResult> evaluateScope({
    required AtlasCatalogProduct selectedProduct,
    required AtlasCompletionScope scope,
    required List<Pop> collectionPops,
    Set<String> ownedWishlistIdentityKeys =
    const <String>{},
    String collectionName = 'All Atlas Collections',
    bool includeWishlist = true,
    bool includeInactiveCatalogItems = false,
    int searchLimit = 500,
  }) async {
    final AtlasTaxonomy selectedTaxonomy =
    _taxonomyService.resolve(
      selectedProduct,
    );

    final AtlasTaxonomyNode? targetNode =
    selectedTaxonomy.nodeForScope(
      scope,
    );

    if (targetNode == null) {
      return AtlasCompletionResult(
        query: AtlasCompletionQuery(
          filters: const <AtlasCompletionFilter>[],
          primaryScope: scope,
          includeWishlist: includeWishlist,
          includeInactiveCatalogItems:
          includeInactiveCatalogItems,
        ),
        items: const [],
      );
    }

    final List<AtlasCatalogProduct> candidates =
    await _findScopeCandidates(
      selectedProduct: selectedProduct,
      scope: scope,
      searchLimit: searchLimit,
    );

    final AtlasCompletionQuery query =
    AtlasCompletionQuery(
      filters: <AtlasCompletionFilter>[
        AtlasCompletionFilter(
          scope: scope,
          nodeId: targetNode.id,
          displayName: targetNode.name,
        ),
      ],
      primaryScope: scope,
      includeWishlist: includeWishlist,
      includeInactiveCatalogItems:
      includeInactiveCatalogItems,
    );

    return _completionEngine.evaluate(
      query: query,
      catalogProducts: candidates,
      collectionPops: collectionPops,
      ownedWishlistIdentityKeys:
      ownedWishlistIdentityKeys,
      collectionName: collectionName,
    );
  }

  Future<List<AtlasCatalogProduct>>
  _findVariantFamilyCandidates({
    required AtlasCatalogProduct selectedProduct,
    required int searchLimit,
  }) async {
    final String? characterName =
    _cleanText(
      selectedProduct.characterName,
    );

    final String? productNumber =
    _cleanText(
      selectedProduct.productNumber,
    );

    final List<AtlasCatalogProduct> products;

    if (characterName != null ||
        productNumber != null) {
      products = await _catalogService.search(
        characterName: characterName,
        productNumber: productNumber,
        limit: searchLimit,
      );
    } else {
      products = await _catalogService.search(
        query: selectedProduct.displayName,
        limit: searchLimit,
      );
    }

    return _includeSelectedProduct(
      selectedProduct: selectedProduct,
      products: products,
    );
  }

  Future<List<AtlasCatalogProduct>>
  _findScopeCandidates({
    required AtlasCatalogProduct selectedProduct,
    required AtlasCompletionScope scope,
    required int searchLimit,
  }) async {
    final List<AtlasCatalogProduct> products =
    switch (scope) {
      AtlasCompletionScope.brand =>
      await _catalogService.search(
        brand: _cleanText(
          selectedProduct.brand,
        ),
        limit: searchLimit,
      ),

      AtlasCompletionScope.franchise =>
      await _catalogService.search(
        productLine: _cleanText(
          selectedProduct.productLine,
        ),
        limit: searchLimit,
      ),

      AtlasCompletionScope.series =>
      await _catalogService.search(
        series: _cleanText(
          selectedProduct.series,
        ),
        limit: searchLimit,
      ),

      AtlasCompletionScope.character =>
      await _catalogService.search(
        characterName: _cleanText(
          selectedProduct.characterName,
        ),
        limit: searchLimit,
      ),

      AtlasCompletionScope.variantFamily =>
      await _catalogService.search(
        characterName: _cleanText(
          selectedProduct.characterName,
        ),
        productNumber: _cleanText(
          selectedProduct.productNumber,
        ),
        limit: searchLimit,
      ),

      AtlasCompletionScope.release =>
      <AtlasCatalogProduct>[
        selectedProduct,
      ],

      _ => await _catalogService.search(
        query: _bestGeneralQuery(
          selectedProduct,
        ),
        limit: searchLimit,
      ),
    };

    return _includeSelectedProduct(
      selectedProduct: selectedProduct,
      products: products,
    );
  }

  AtlasCompletionResult _evaluateExactRelease({
    required AtlasCatalogProduct selectedProduct,
    required AtlasTaxonomy selectedTaxonomy,
    required List<Pop> collectionPops,
    required Set<String> ownedWishlistIdentityKeys,
    required String collectionName,
    required bool includeWishlist,
    required bool includeInactiveCatalogItems,
  }) {
    final AtlasTaxonomyNode? releaseNode =
    selectedTaxonomy.nodeForScope(
      AtlasCompletionScope.release,
    );

    final List<AtlasCompletionFilter> filters =
    releaseNode == null
        ? const <AtlasCompletionFilter>[]
        : <AtlasCompletionFilter>[
      AtlasCompletionFilter(
        scope: AtlasCompletionScope.release,
        nodeId: releaseNode.id,
        displayName: releaseNode.name,
      ),
    ];

    final AtlasCompletionQuery query =
    AtlasCompletionQuery(
      filters: filters,
      primaryScope: AtlasCompletionScope.release,
      includeWishlist: includeWishlist,
      includeInactiveCatalogItems:
      includeInactiveCatalogItems,
    );

    return _completionEngine.evaluate(
      query: query,
      catalogProducts: <AtlasCatalogProduct>[
        selectedProduct,
      ],
      collectionPops: collectionPops,
      ownedWishlistIdentityKeys:
      ownedWishlistIdentityKeys,
      collectionName: collectionName,
    );
  }

  List<AtlasCatalogProduct> _includeSelectedProduct({
    required AtlasCatalogProduct selectedProduct,
    required Iterable<AtlasCatalogProduct> products,
  }) {
    final Map<String, AtlasCatalogProduct> productsById =
    <String, AtlasCatalogProduct>{};

    void addProduct(
        AtlasCatalogProduct product,
        ) {
      final String productId =
      product.productId.value.trim();

      final String key = productId.isEmpty
          ? _fallbackProductKey(
        product,
      )
          : productId.toLowerCase();

      productsById.putIfAbsent(
        key,
            () => product,
      );
    }

    addProduct(
      selectedProduct,
    );

    for (final AtlasCatalogProduct product
    in products) {
      addProduct(
        product,
      );
    }

    return List<AtlasCatalogProduct>.unmodifiable(
      productsById.values,
    );
  }

  String _bestGeneralQuery(
      AtlasCatalogProduct product,
      ) {
    return _cleanText(
      product.characterName,
    ) ??
        _cleanText(
          product.series,
        ) ??
        _cleanText(
          product.productLine,
        ) ??
        product.displayName;
  }

  String _fallbackProductKey(
      AtlasCatalogProduct product,
      ) {
    final String normalizedName =
    _normalizeText(
      product.displayName,
    );

    final String normalizedNumber =
    _normalizeText(
      product.productNumber ?? '',
    );

    final String normalizedVariant =
    _normalizeText(
      product.variantName ?? '',
    );

    final String normalizedBarcodes =
    product.barcodes
        .map(
      _normalizeBarcode,
    )
        .where(
          (
          String barcode,
          ) {
        return barcode.isNotEmpty;
      },
    )
        .join(
      '|',
    );

    return <String>[
      'fallback',
      normalizedName,
      normalizedNumber,
      normalizedVariant,
      normalizedBarcodes,
    ].join(
      ':',
    );
  }

  String? _cleanText(
      String? value,
      ) {
    final String cleaned =
        value?.trim() ?? '';

    return cleaned.isEmpty
        ? null
        : cleaned;
  }

  String _normalizeText(
      String value,
      ) {
    return value
        .trim()
        .toLowerCase()
        .replaceAll(
      RegExp(r'[^a-z0-9]+'),
      ' ',
    )
        .replaceAll(
      RegExp(r'\s+'),
      ' ',
    )
        .trim();
  }

  String _normalizeBarcode(
      String value,
      ) {
    return value.replaceAll(
      RegExp(r'[^0-9A-Za-z]'),
      '',
    );
  }
}

import '../atlas/market/models/value_history_entry.dart';
import '../atlas/timeline/models/atlas_timeline_event.dart';

class Pop {
  final String id;

  final String name;
  final String number;

  final String category;
  final String series;

  final String edition;
  final String variant;
  final String retailExclusive;
  final String eventSticker;
  final String limitedEdition;
  final String signature;

  // External catalog identity.
  //
  // For HobbyDB imports:
  // sourceCatalogId = HDBID
  // sourceCollectibleId = HDBC Number
  // sourceUpc = UPC
  final String sourceCatalogId;
  final String sourceCollectibleId;
  final String sourceUpc;

  // Additional source metadata that helps Atlas preserve and explain
  // imported collectible releases.
  final String productionStatus;
  final String releaseDate;
  final String gradingCompany;
  final String authenticityNumber;

  // Physical release identity metadata.
  //
  // These fields describe meaningful release or packaging differences.
  // They do not describe the collector's individual copy condition.
  final String finish;
  final String size;
  final String packagingType;
  final String boxVersion;
  final String copyrightYear;
  final String productionCode;
  final String stickerType;
  final String authenticationProvider;

  final double value;
  final double pricePaid;

  // Chronological estimated-value records for this collectible.
  //
  // Legacy Pops may begin with a single synthesized history entry based on
  // their existing [value] and last known update date.
  final List<ValueHistoryEntry> valueHistory;

  // Chronological collector and market events for this collectible.
  final List<AtlasTimelineEvent> timeline;

  final int quantity;

  final String itemCondition;
  final String boxCondition;

  final String imageUrl;

  final String owner;

  final bool isWishlist;

  final String dateAdded;
  final String lastUpdated;

  const Pop({
    required this.id,
    required this.name,
    required this.number,
    required this.category,
    required this.series,
    this.edition = 'Common',
    this.variant = 'Common',
    this.retailExclusive = 'None',
    this.eventSticker = 'None',
    this.limitedEdition = 'None',
    this.signature = 'Unsigned',
    this.sourceCatalogId = '',
    this.sourceCollectibleId = '',
    this.sourceUpc = '',
    this.productionStatus = '',
    this.releaseDate = '',
    this.gradingCompany = '',
    this.authenticityNumber = '',
    this.finish = 'Standard',
    this.size = 'Standard 4 Inch',
    this.packagingType = 'Single',
    this.boxVersion = '',
    this.copyrightYear = '',
    this.productionCode = '',
    this.stickerType = '',
    this.authenticationProvider = '',
    required this.value,
    required this.pricePaid,
    this.valueHistory = const [],
    this.timeline = const [],
    required this.quantity,
    required this.itemCondition,
    required this.boxCondition,
    required this.imageUrl,
    required this.owner,
    required this.isWishlist,
    this.dateAdded = '',
    this.lastUpdated = '',
  });

  factory Pop.fromJson(
      Map<String, dynamic> json,
      ) {
    final parsedId = json['id']?.toString() ?? '';
    final legacyEdition = json['edition'] ?? 'Common';

    final parsedValue = _readDouble(json['value']);
    final parsedDateAdded = json['dateAdded']?.toString() ?? '';
    final parsedLastUpdated = json['lastUpdated']?.toString() ?? '';

    final parsedValueHistory = _readValueHistory(
      json['valueHistory'],
      currentValue: parsedValue,
      dateAdded: parsedDateAdded,
      lastUpdated: parsedLastUpdated,
    );

    final parsedTimeline = _readTimeline(
      json['timeline'],
      popId: parsedId,
      dateAdded: parsedDateAdded,
    );

    return Pop(
      id: parsedId,
      name: json['name'] ?? '',
      number: json['number'] ?? '',
      category: json['category'] ?? '',
      series: json['series'] ?? '',
      edition: legacyEdition,
      variant: json['variant'] ?? legacyEdition,
      retailExclusive: json['retailExclusive'] ?? 'None',
      eventSticker: json['eventSticker'] ?? 'None',
      limitedEdition: json['limitedEdition'] ?? 'None',
      signature: json['signature'] ?? 'Unsigned',
      sourceCatalogId: json['sourceCatalogId'] ?? '',
      sourceCollectibleId: json['sourceCollectibleId'] ?? '',
      sourceUpc: json['sourceUpc'] ?? '',
      productionStatus: json['productionStatus'] ?? '',
      releaseDate: json['releaseDate'] ?? '',
      gradingCompany: json['gradingCompany'] ?? '',
      authenticityNumber: json['authenticityNumber'] ?? '',
      finish: json['finish'] ?? 'Standard',
      size: json['size'] ?? 'Standard 4 Inch',
      packagingType: json['packagingType'] ?? 'Single',
      boxVersion: json['boxVersion'] ?? '',
      copyrightYear: json['copyrightYear'] ?? '',
      productionCode: json['productionCode'] ?? '',
      stickerType: json['stickerType'] ?? '',
      authenticationProvider:
      json['authenticationProvider'] ?? '',
      value: parsedValue,
      pricePaid: _readDouble(json['pricePaid']),
      valueHistory: parsedValueHistory,
      timeline: parsedTimeline,
      quantity: _readInt(json['quantity'], fallback: 1),
      itemCondition: json['itemCondition'] ?? '',
      boxCondition: json['boxCondition'] ?? '',
      imageUrl: json['imageUrl'] ?? '',
      owner: json['owner'] ?? 'Shared',
      isWishlist: json['isWishlist'] ?? false,
      dateAdded: parsedDateAdded,
      lastUpdated: parsedLastUpdated,
    );
  }

  /// Identifies the exact collectible release itself for CONFIRMED duplicates.
  ///
  /// No single external identifier is trusted by itself.
  ///
  /// Catalog IDs and UPCs are strong identity evidence, but Funko releases may
  /// reuse UPCs or third-party catalogs may group multiple physical variants
  /// under one record. Release-defining attributes are therefore always included.
  String get collectibleIdentityKey {
    final catalogId = normalizeIdentityText(sourceCatalogId);
    final collectibleId = normalizeIdentityText(sourceCollectibleId);
    final upc = normalizeIdentityText(sourceUpc);

    final normalizedName = normalizeIdentityText(name);
    final normalizedNumber = normalizeIdentityText(number);
    final normalizedCategory = normalizeIdentityText(category);
    final normalizedSeries = normalizeIdentityText(series);

    final identityAnchor = _buildIdentityAnchor(
      catalogId: catalogId,
      collectibleId: collectibleId,
      upc: upc,
      normalizedName: normalizedName,
      normalizedNumber: normalizedNumber,
      normalizedCategory: normalizedCategory,
      normalizedSeries: normalizedSeries,
    );

    if (identityAnchor.isEmpty) {
      return '';
    }

    return <String>[
      'release',
      identityAnchor,
      ..._releaseIdentityParts,
    ].join('|');
  }

  /// Broad identity key used to group POSSIBLE duplicates for review.
  ///
  /// This intentionally ignores release-defining differences such as Chase,
  /// stickers, finishes, signatures, box versions, and production codes.
  ///
  /// Examples:
  ///
  /// Same UPC but Common vs Chase:
  ///   grouped for review, not confirmed as duplicates.
  ///
  /// Same number and series with slightly different names:
  ///   grouped for review.
  ///
  /// Same number in different Funko lines:
  ///   not grouped together.
  String get similarityReviewKey {
    final upc = normalizeIdentityText(sourceUpc);

    if (upc.isNotEmpty) {
      return 'upc_review|$upc';
    }

    final collectibleId = normalizeIdentityText(sourceCollectibleId);

    if (collectibleId.isNotEmpty) {
      return 'collectible_review|$collectibleId';
    }

    final catalogId = normalizeIdentityText(sourceCatalogId);

    if (catalogId.isNotEmpty) {
      return 'catalog_review|$catalogId';
    }

    final normalizedNumber = normalizeIdentityText(number);
    final normalizedCategory = normalizeIdentityText(category);
    final normalizedSeries = normalizeIdentityText(series);
    final normalizedName = normalizeIdentityText(name);

    if (normalizedNumber.isEmpty) {
      return '';
    }

    // Preferred manual review identity:
    // Number + Funko line/category + series.
    //
    // Name is intentionally omitted here so entries such as:
    // "Spider-Man" and "Spider Man"
    // can still be reviewed together.
    if (normalizedCategory.isNotEmpty && normalizedSeries.isNotEmpty) {
      return <String>[
        'line_review',
        normalizedNumber,
        normalizedCategory,
        normalizedSeries,
      ].join('|');
    }

    // When series is missing, retain the name to avoid grouping every #01
    // in a broad category together.
    if (normalizedCategory.isNotEmpty && normalizedName.isNotEmpty) {
      return <String>[
        'category_review',
        normalizedNumber,
        normalizedCategory,
        normalizedName,
      ].join('|');
    }

    // Last-resort review key. This is deliberately conservative.
    if (normalizedSeries.isNotEmpty && normalizedName.isNotEmpty) {
      return <String>[
        'series_review',
        normalizedNumber,
        normalizedSeries,
        normalizedName,
      ].join('|');
    }

    return '';
  }

  /// Builds the strongest available core identity anchor.
  ///
  /// The anchor identifies the probable catalog object. Physical release
  /// attributes are appended separately through [_releaseIdentityParts].
  String _buildIdentityAnchor({
    required String catalogId,
    required String collectibleId,
    required String upc,
    required String normalizedName,
    required String normalizedNumber,
    required String normalizedCategory,
    required String normalizedSeries,
  }) {
    if (collectibleId.isNotEmpty) {
      return 'collectible|$collectibleId';
    }

    if (catalogId.isNotEmpty) {
      return 'catalog|$catalogId';
    }

    if (upc.isNotEmpty) {
      return 'upc|$upc';
    }

    if (normalizedNumber.isEmpty) {
      return '';
    }

    // Number alone is never enough because every Funko line can restart at #01.
    if (normalizedCategory.isEmpty && normalizedSeries.isEmpty) {
      return '';
    }

    return <String>[
      'manual',
      normalizedName,
      normalizedNumber,
      normalizedCategory,
      normalizedSeries,
    ].join('|');
  }

  /// Release-defining attributes used by exact duplicate detection.
  ///
  /// Any meaningful difference here represents either:
  ///
  /// - another variant,
  /// - another sticker release,
  /// - another package format,
  /// - another box version,
  /// - another production run,
  /// - or another authenticated collectible.
  List<String> get _releaseIdentityParts {
    return <String>[
      normalizeVariantIdentity(edition),
      normalizeVariantIdentity(variant),
      normalizeVariantIdentity(finish),
      normalizeOptionalIdentity(retailExclusive),
      normalizeOptionalIdentity(eventSticker),
      normalizeOptionalIdentity(stickerType),
      normalizeOptionalIdentity(limitedEdition),
      normalizeSignatureIdentity(signature),
      normalizeOptionalIdentity(authenticationProvider),
      normalizeOptionalIdentity(gradingCompany),
      normalizeOptionalIdentity(authenticityNumber),
      normalizeOptionalIdentity(size),
      normalizeOptionalIdentity(packagingType),
      normalizeOptionalIdentity(boxVersion),
      normalizeOptionalIdentity(copyrightYear),
      normalizeOptionalIdentity(productionCode),
    ];
  }

  /// Identifies one stored record in a collection.
  ///
  /// Owner and wishlist status remain separate so different collectors and
  /// owned/wishlist records are never merged together.
  String get collectionRecordKey {
    final collectibleKey = collectibleIdentityKey;

    if (collectibleKey.isEmpty) {
      return '';
    }

    return [
      collectibleKey,
      normalizeIdentityText(owner),
      isWishlist ? 'wishlist' : 'owned',
    ].join('|');
  }

  String get csvImportKey => collectionRecordKey;

  String get duplicateKey => collectionRecordKey;

  String get collectorIdentity => collectibleIdentityKey;

  String get collectorLabel {
    final parts = <String>[
      variant,
      retailExclusive,
      eventSticker,
      limitedEdition,
      signature,
    ].where(hasMeaningfulIdentityLabel);

    if (parts.isEmpty) {
      return 'Common';
    }

    return parts.join(' â€¢ ');
  }

  static double _readDouble(dynamic rawValue) {
    if (rawValue is num) {
      return rawValue.toDouble();
    }

    return double.tryParse(
      rawValue?.toString().trim() ?? '',
    ) ??
        0;
  }

  static int _readInt(
      dynamic rawValue, {
        required int fallback,
      }) {
    if (rawValue is int) {
      return rawValue;
    }

    if (rawValue is num) {
      return rawValue.toInt();
    }

    return int.tryParse(
      rawValue?.toString().trim() ?? '',
    ) ??
        fallback;
  }

  static List<ValueHistoryEntry> _readValueHistory(
      dynamic rawHistory, {
        required double currentValue,
        required String dateAdded,
        required String lastUpdated,
      }) {
    final entries = <ValueHistoryEntry>[];

    if (rawHistory is List) {
      for (final rawEntry in rawHistory) {
        if (rawEntry is! Map) {
          continue;
        }

        final entry = ValueHistoryEntry.fromJson(
          Map<String, dynamic>.from(rawEntry),
        );

        if (entry.value <= 0) {
          continue;
        }

        entries.add(entry);
      }
    }

    if (entries.isNotEmpty) {
      entries.sort(
            (a, b) => a.recordedAt.compareTo(b.recordedAt),
      );

      return List<ValueHistoryEntry>.unmodifiable(entries);
    }

    if (currentValue <= 0) {
      return const [];
    }

    final recordedAt =
        DateTime.tryParse(lastUpdated) ??
            DateTime.tryParse(dateAdded) ??
            DateTime.fromMillisecondsSinceEpoch(0);

    return List<ValueHistoryEntry>.unmodifiable(
      <ValueHistoryEntry>[
        ValueHistoryEntry(
          value: currentValue,
          recordedAt: recordedAt,
          source: ValueHistoryEntry.legacyValueSource,
        ),
      ],
    );
  }

  static List<AtlasTimelineEvent> _readTimeline(
      dynamic rawTimeline, {
        required String popId,
        required String dateAdded,
      }) {
    final events = <AtlasTimelineEvent>[];

    if (rawTimeline is List) {
      for (final rawEvent in rawTimeline) {
        if (rawEvent is! Map) {
          continue;
        }

        final event = AtlasTimelineEvent.fromJson(
          Map<String, dynamic>.from(rawEvent),
        );

        events.add(event);
      }
    }

    if (events.isNotEmpty) {
      events.sort(
            (a, b) => a.occurredAt.compareTo(b.occurredAt),
      );

      return List<AtlasTimelineEvent>.unmodifiable(events);
    }

    final addedAt = DateTime.tryParse(dateAdded);

    if (popId.isEmpty || addedAt == null) {
      return const [];
    }

    return List<AtlasTimelineEvent>.unmodifiable(
      <AtlasTimelineEvent>[
        AtlasTimelineEvent(
          id: 'legacy-added-$popId',
          popId: popId,
          type: AtlasTimelineEventType.addedToVault,
          occurredAt: addedAt,
          title: 'Added to Vault',
          createdBy: AtlasTimelineEvent.systemCreatedBy,
          createdAt: addedAt,
        ),
      ],
    );
  }

  // Cleans strings by lowercasing and stripping non-alphanumeric characters.
  // Converts "Spider-Man #01!" -> "spiderman01"
  static String normalizeIdentityText(String value) {
    return value
        .trim()
        .toLowerCase()
        .replaceAll(RegExp(r'[^a-z0-9]'), '');
  }

  static String normalizeVariantIdentity(String value) {
    final cleaned = normalizeIdentityText(value);

    if (cleaned.isEmpty ||
        cleaned == 'none' ||
        cleaned == 'no' ||
        cleaned == 'na' ||
        cleaned == 'common' ||
        cleaned == 'standard') {
      return 'common';
    }

    return cleaned;
  }

  static String normalizeOptionalIdentity(String value) {
    final cleaned = normalizeIdentityText(value);

    if (cleaned.isEmpty ||
        cleaned == 'none' ||
        cleaned == 'no' ||
        cleaned == 'na') {
      return 'none';
    }

    return cleaned;
  }

  static String normalizeSignatureIdentity(String value) {
    final cleaned = normalizeIdentityText(value);

    if (cleaned.isEmpty ||
        cleaned == 'none' ||
        cleaned == 'no' ||
        cleaned == 'na' ||
        cleaned == 'unsigned') {
      return 'unsigned';
    }

    return cleaned;
  }

  static bool hasMeaningfulIdentityLabel(String value) {
    final cleaned = normalizeIdentityText(value);

    return cleaned.isNotEmpty &&
        cleaned != 'none' &&
        cleaned != 'no' &&
        cleaned != 'na' &&
        cleaned != 'unsigned' &&
        cleaned != 'common' &&
        cleaned != 'standard';
  }
}

class AtlasCollectorAction {

    required this.type,
    required this.label,
    required this.icon,
    required this.priority,
    this.isPrimary = false,
  });

  final AtlasCollectorActionType type;

  final IconData icon;

    AtlasCollectorActionType? type,
    String? label,
    IconData? icon,
    int? priority,
    bool? isPrimary,
  }) {
    return AtlasCollectorAction(
      type: type ?? this.type,
      label: label ?? this.label,
      icon: icon ?? this.icon,
      priority: priority ?? this.priority,
      isPrimary: isPrimary ?? this.isPrimary,
    );
  }

  @override
  bool operator ==(Object other) {
    return identical(this, other) ||
        other is AtlasCollectorAction &&
            runtimeType == other.runtimeType &&
            type == other.type &&
            label == other.label &&
            icon == other.icon &&
            priority == other.priority &&
            isPrimary == other.isPrimary;
  }

  @override
  int get hashCode {
    return Object.hash(
      type,
      label,
      icon,
      priority,
      isPrimary,
    );
  }
}

import 'package:flutter/material.dart';

import 'atlas_collector_action.dart';

class AtlasCollectorActionContext {
  const AtlasCollectorActionContext({
    required this.isOwned,
    required this.isWishlisted,
    required this.canViewExistingItem,
    this.includeScanAnother = true,
  });

  final bool isOwned;
  final bool isWishlisted;
  final bool canViewExistingItem;
  final bool includeScanAnother;
}

class AtlasCollectorActionEngine {
  const AtlasCollectorActionEngine();

  List<AtlasCollectorAction> buildActions(
      AtlasCollectorActionContext context,
      ) {
    final List<AtlasCollectorAction> actions = <AtlasCollectorAction>[];

    if (context.isOwned && context.canViewExistingItem) {
      actions.add(
        const AtlasCollectorAction(
          type: AtlasCollectorActionType.viewExistingItem,
          label: 'View Existing Item',
          icon: Icons.visibility_outlined,
          priority: 10,
          isPrimary: true,
        ),
      );

      actions.add(
        const AtlasCollectorAction(
          type: AtlasCollectorActionType.addAnotherCopy,
          label: 'Add Another Copy',
          icon: Icons.add_circle_outline_rounded,
          priority: 20,
        ),
      );

      actions.add(
        const AtlasCollectorAction(
          type: AtlasCollectorActionType.reviewVariantSticker,
          label: 'Review Variant / Sticker',
          icon: Icons.verified_outlined,
          priority: 30,
        ),
      );

      actions.add(
        const AtlasCollectorAction(
          type: AtlasCollectorActionType.updateCondition,
          label: 'Update Condition',
          icon: Icons.inventory_2_outlined,
          priority: 40,
        ),
      );
    } else {
      actions.add(
        const AtlasCollectorAction(
          type: AtlasCollectorActionType.addToVault,
          label: 'Add to Vault',
          icon: Icons.add_circle_rounded,
          priority: 10,
          isPrimary: true,
        ),
      );
    }

    if (context.isWishlisted) {
      actions.add(
        const AtlasCollectorAction(
          type: AtlasCollectorActionType.removeFromWishlist,
          label: 'Remove from Wishlist',
          icon: Icons.heart_broken_rounded,
          priority: 50,
        ),
      );
    } else {
      actions.add(
        const AtlasCollectorAction(
          type: AtlasCollectorActionType.addToWishlist,
          label: 'Add to Wishlist',
          icon: Icons.favorite_border_rounded,
          priority: 50,
        ),
      );
    }

    if (context.includeScanAnother) {
      actions.add(
        const AtlasCollectorAction(
          type: AtlasCollectorActionType.scanAnother,
          label: 'Scan Another',
          icon: Icons.qr_code_scanner_rounded,
          priority: 100,
        ),
      );
    }

    actions.sort(
          (
          AtlasCollectorAction first,
          AtlasCollectorAction second,
          ) {
        return first.priority.compareTo(second.priority);
      },
    );

    return List<AtlasCollectorAction>.unmodifiable(actions);
  }
}

enum AtlasPerceptionFrameDisposition {
  processed,
  rejectedQuality,
  skippedCadence,

/// Immutable result emitted for one sampled perception frame.
///
/// Expired tracks are represented as IDs because spatial staleness remains
/// authoritative in AtlasObjectTracker; this model does not create a second
/// competing stale-track lifecycle.
final class AtlasPerceptionFrameResult {
  AtlasPerceptionFrameResult({
    required this.timestamp,
    required this.disposition,
    required this.qualityAssessment,
    List<AtlasContinuousCandidate> candidates =
        const <AtlasContinuousCandidate>[],
    Set<String> expiredTrackIds = const <String>{},
    Set<String> submittedTrackIds = const <String>{},
  }) : candidates = List<AtlasContinuousCandidate>.unmodifiable(candidates),
       expiredTrackIds = Set<String>.unmodifiable(expiredTrackIds),
       submittedTrackIds = Set<String>.unmodifiable(submittedTrackIds);

  final DateTime timestamp;
  final AtlasPerceptionFrameDisposition disposition;
  final AtlasFrameQualityAssessment qualityAssessment;
  final List<AtlasContinuousCandidate> candidates;
  final Set<String> expiredTrackIds;
  final Set<String> submittedTrackIds;

  bool get wasProcessed =>
      disposition == AtlasPerceptionFrameDisposition.processed;

  bool get wasQualityRejected =>
      disposition == AtlasPerceptionFrameDisposition.rejectedQuality;

  bool get wasCadenceSkipped =>
      disposition == AtlasPerceptionFrameDisposition.skippedCadence;
}

import 'dart:async';

import '../acquisition/atlas_evidence_accumulator.dart';
import '../models/scan_code.dart';
import '../tracking/atlas_object_track.dart';
import '../tracking/atlas_object_tracker.dart';
import '../tracking/atlas_scan_observation.dart';
import 'atlas_continuous_candidate_projector.dart';
import 'atlas_frame_triage_gate.dart';
import 'models/atlas_continuous_candidate.dart';
import 'models/atlas_frame_quality_assessment.dart';
import 'models/atlas_perception_frame_result.dart';

typedef AtlasStableCandidateSubmitter =
    bool Function({required String trackId, required ScanCode stableCode});

final class AtlasContinuousPerceptionConfig {
  const AtlasContinuousPerceptionConfig({
    this.minimumFrameInterval = const Duration(milliseconds: 250),
  });

  /// Default 250 ms cadence targets approximately 4 FPS, inside the 3-5 FPS
  /// continuous-perception budget. Callers may tune this without changing the
  /// tracking or evidence contracts.
  final Duration minimumFrameInterval;
}

/// Shared 6A foundation for camera Shelf Scan and future live-feed ingestion.
///
/// Responsibilities:
/// - sample cadence enforcement
/// - frame-quality fast-fail
/// - reuse AtlasObjectTracker for spatial persistence
/// - reuse AtlasEvidenceAccumulator for stable barcode agreement
/// - emit transient candidate/result models for HUD consumers
/// - optionally cross the existing Scanner 4 submission boundary
///
/// This coordinator never mutates the Vault and never rewrites product identity.
final class AtlasContinuousPerceptionCoordinator {
  AtlasContinuousPerceptionCoordinator({
    AtlasObjectTracker? objectTracker,
    AtlasEvidenceAccumulator? evidenceAccumulator,
    AtlasFrameTriageGate? frameTriageGate,
    this.submitStableCandidate,
    this.config = const AtlasContinuousPerceptionConfig(),
  }) : objectTracker = objectTracker ?? AtlasObjectTracker(),
       evidenceAccumulator = evidenceAccumulator ?? AtlasEvidenceAccumulator(),
       frameTriageGate = frameTriageGate ?? AtlasFrameTriageGate() {
    if (config.minimumFrameInterval.isNegative) {
      throw ArgumentError.value(
        config.minimumFrameInterval,
        'minimumFrameInterval',
        'minimumFrameInterval cannot be negative.',
      );
    }
  }

  final AtlasObjectTracker objectTracker;
  final AtlasEvidenceAccumulator evidenceAccumulator;
  final AtlasFrameTriageGate frameTriageGate;
  final AtlasStableCandidateSubmitter? submitStableCandidate;
  final AtlasContinuousPerceptionConfig config;

  final StreamController<AtlasPerceptionFrameResult> _resultsController =
      StreamController<AtlasPerceptionFrameResult>.broadcast(sync: true);

  final Set<String> _knownTrackIds = <String>{};
  final Set<String> _submittedTrackIds = <String>{};

  DateTime? _lastInputAt;
  DateTime? _lastProcessedAt;
  AtlasPerceptionFrameResult? _latestResult;
  bool _isDisposed = false;

  Stream<AtlasPerceptionFrameResult> get results => _resultsController.stream;

  AtlasPerceptionFrameResult? get latestResult => _latestResult;

  AtlasPerceptionFrameResult processFrame({
    required DateTime timestamp,
    required List<AtlasScanObservation> observations,
    AtlasFrameQualitySample? qualitySample,
  }) {
    if (_isDisposed) {
      throw StateError('AtlasContinuousPerceptionCoordinator is disposed.');
    }

    final DateTime normalizedTimestamp = timestamp.toUtc();
    final DateTime? previousInput = _lastInputAt;
    if (previousInput != null && normalizedTimestamp.isBefore(previousInput)) {
      throw ArgumentError.value(
        timestamp,
        'timestamp',
        'Frame timestamps must be monotonic.',
      );
    }
    _lastInputAt = normalizedTimestamp;

    final AtlasFrameQualityAssessment qualityAssessment = frameTriageGate
        .evaluate(qualitySample ?? AtlasFrameQualitySample());

    final DateTime? previousProcessed = _lastProcessedAt;
    if (previousProcessed != null &&
        normalizedTimestamp.difference(previousProcessed) <
            config.minimumFrameInterval) {
      return _emit(
        AtlasPerceptionFrameResult(
          timestamp: normalizedTimestamp,
          disposition: AtlasPerceptionFrameDisposition.skippedCadence,
          qualityAssessment: qualityAssessment,
          candidates: _projectCurrentCandidates(),
        ),
      );
    }

    _lastProcessedAt = normalizedTimestamp;

    final List<AtlasObjectTrack> tracked = objectTracker.processFrame(
      observations: qualityAssessment.isAccepted
          ? observations
          : const <AtlasScanObservation>[],
      timestamp: normalizedTimestamp,
    );

    final Set<String> currentTrackIds = tracked
        .map((AtlasObjectTrack track) => track.trackId)
        .toSet();
    final Set<String> expiredTrackIds = _knownTrackIds.difference(
      currentTrackIds,
    );
    _knownTrackIds
      ..clear()
      ..addAll(currentTrackIds);

    final Set<String> submittedThisFrame = <String>{};

    if (qualityAssessment.isAccepted && submitStableCandidate != null) {
      for (final AtlasObjectTrack track in tracked) {
        if (track.isCooldown || _submittedTrackIds.contains(track.trackId)) {
          continue;
        }

        final AtlasAccumulatedEvidence? evidence = evidenceAccumulator
            .evaluateTrack(track);
        if (evidence == null || !evidence.isReadyForResolution) {
          continue;
        }

        final bool accepted = submitStableCandidate!(
          trackId: track.trackId,
          stableCode: evidence.stableCode,
        );

        if (accepted) {
          _submittedTrackIds.add(track.trackId);
          submittedThisFrame.add(track.trackId);
          objectTracker.markCooldown(
            trackId: track.trackId,
            startedAt: normalizedTimestamp,
          );
        }
      }
    }

    final AtlasPerceptionFrameResult result = AtlasPerceptionFrameResult(
      timestamp: normalizedTimestamp,
      disposition: qualityAssessment.isAccepted
          ? AtlasPerceptionFrameDisposition.processed
          : AtlasPerceptionFrameDisposition.rejectedQuality,
      qualityAssessment: qualityAssessment,
      candidates: _projectCurrentCandidates(),
      expiredTrackIds: expiredTrackIds,
      submittedTrackIds: submittedThisFrame,
    );

    return _emit(result);
  }

  void reset() {
    if (_isDisposed) return;
    objectTracker.reset();
    _knownTrackIds.clear();
    _submittedTrackIds.clear();
    _lastInputAt = null;
    _lastProcessedAt = null;
    _latestResult = null;
  }

  Future<void> dispose() async {
    if (_isDisposed) return;
    _isDisposed = true;
    await _resultsController.close();
  }

  List<AtlasContinuousCandidate> _projectCurrentCandidates() {
    return objectTracker.tracks
        .map((AtlasObjectTrack track) {
          final AtlasAccumulatedEvidence? evidence = evidenceAccumulator
              .evaluateTrack(track);
          return AtlasContinuousCandidateProjector.project(
            track: track,
            accumulatedEvidence: evidence,
          );
        })
        .toList(growable: false);
  }

  AtlasPerceptionFrameResult _emit(AtlasPerceptionFrameResult result) {
    _latestResult = result;
    _resultsController.add(result);
    return result;
  }
}

import 'package:flutter/material.dart';
import 'package:provider/provider.dart';

import 'entire_vault_screen.dart';
import '../../atlas/repositories/vault_repository.dart';
import '../../models/pop.dart';
import '../../services/app_state.dart';

class AtlasRoomScreen extends StatelessWidget {
  const AtlasRoomScreen({
    super.key,
    required this.roomName,
    required this.description,
    required this.icon,
    this.categoryName,
    this.collectionName,
  });

  final String roomName;
  final String description;
  final IconData icon;
  final String? categoryName;
  final String? collectionName;

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) {
    final appState = context.watch<AppState>();
    const repository = VaultRepository();

    final allPops = collectionName == null
        ? repository.allPops(appState)
        : appState.popsForCollection(collectionName!);

    final roomPops = _roomPops(allPops);

    final roomValue = roomPops.fold<double>(
      0,
          (total, pop) => total + pop.value,
    );

    final wishlistCount = roomPops
        .where(
          (pop) => pop.isWishlist,
    )
        .length;

    final missingValueCount = roomPops
        .where(
          (pop) => pop.value <= 0,
    )
        .length;

    final previewPops = roomPops.take(5).toList();

    return Scaffold(
      appBar: AppBar(
        title: Text(roomName),
      ),
      body: VaultScrollView(
        children: [
          AtlasGlassCard(
            accentColor: AtlasColors.vaultGold,
            child: Column(
              crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.start,
              children: [
                AtlasSectionHeader(
                  title: roomName,
                  subtitle: description,
                  icon: icon,
                  titleStyle: AtlasTypography.headingLarge,
                  accentColor: AtlasColors.vaultGold,
                ),
                const SizedBox(
                  height: AtlasSpacing.lg,
                ),
                _RoomStatsPanel(
                  totalPops: roomPops.length,
                  totalValue: roomValue,
                  wishlistCount: wishlistCount,
                ),
                const SizedBox(
                  height: AtlasSpacing.lg,
                ),
                AtlasInfoBanner(
                  icon: Icons.auto_awesome_rounded,
                  title: _roomStatusText(
                    roomPops.length,
                  ),
                  message: _roomDescriptionText(
                    roomPops.length,
                  ),
                ),
                const SizedBox(
                  height: AtlasSpacing.lg,
                ),
                SizedBox(
                  width: double.infinity,
                  child: FilledButton.icon(
                    onPressed: () {
                      Navigator.push(
                        context,
                        MaterialPageRoute(
                          builder: (_) =>
                              FunkoCatalogScreen(
                                collectionName: collectionName,
                              ),
                        ),
                      );
                    },
                    icon: const Icon(
                      Icons.search_rounded,
                    ),
                    label: const Text(
                      'Browse Catalog',
                    ),
                  ),
                ),
                if (collectionName != null) ...[
                  const SizedBox(
                    height: AtlasSpacing.sm,
                  ),
                  SizedBox(
                    width: double.infinity,
                    child: OutlinedButton.icon(
                      key: const ValueKey('open-full-collection'),
                      onPressed: () {
                        Navigator.push(
                          context,
                          MaterialPageRoute<void>(
                            builder: (_) => EntireVaultScreen(
                              collectionName: collectionName,
                            ),
                          ),
                        );
                      },
                      icon: const Icon(
                        Icons.inventory_2_outlined,
                      ),
                      label: const Text(
                        'Open Full Collection',
                      ),
                    ),
                  ),
                ],
              ],
            ),
          ),
          const SizedBox(
            height: AtlasSpacing.lg,
          ),
          _RoomInsightCard(
            roomName: roomName,
            totalPops: roomPops.length,
            totalValue: roomValue,
            wishlistCount: wishlistCount,
            missingValueCount: missingValueCount,
          ),
          const SizedBox(
            height: AtlasSpacing.lg,
          ),
          _RoomPopPreviewCard(
            roomName: roomName,
            roomPops: previewPops,
            totalRoomPops: roomPops.length,
          ),
        ],
      ),
    );
  }

  List<Pop> _roomPops(List<Pop> pops) {
    final category = categoryName
        ?.trim()
        .toLowerCase();

    if (category == null || category.isEmpty) {
      return pops;
    }

    return pops.where(
          (pop) {
        return pop.category
            .trim()
            .toLowerCase() ==
            category;
      },
    ).toList();
  }

  String _roomStatusText(int roomPopCount) {
    if (collectionName != null) {
      if (roomPopCount == 0) {
        return 'This collection is ready for its first Pop.';
      }

      return 'Atlas found $roomPopCount '
          'Pop${roomPopCount == 1 ? '' : 's'} in this collection.';
    }

    if (categoryName == null ||
        categoryName!.trim().isEmpty) {
      return 'Room filters are coming soon.';
    }

    if (roomPopCount == 0) {
      return 'No matching Pops found yet.';
    }

    return 'Atlas found $roomPopCount matching '
        'Pop${roomPopCount == 1 ? '' : 's'}.';
  }

  String _roomDescriptionText(int roomPopCount) {
    if (collectionName != null) {
      if (roomPopCount == 0) {
        return 'Add Pops to this collection to build its stats, value '
            'insights, wishlist tracking, and Atlas recommendations.';
      }

      return 'This collection room is connected to your collection data. '
          'Use it to review stats, value insights, wishlist targets, '
          'and your current Pop preview.';
    }

    if (categoryName == null ||
        categoryName!.trim().isEmpty) {
      return 'This room will eventually show matching Pops from your '
          'vault, quick stats, value insights, missing grails, wishlist '
          'targets, and Atlas recommendations for this category.';
    }

    if (roomPopCount == 0) {
      return 'Once you add Pops in this category, this room will show '
          'vault stats, value insights, wishlist targets, and Atlas '
          'recommendations.';
    }

    return 'This room is now connected to your vault data. Next, we can '
        'add grail tracking, missing value warnings, and room-specific '
        'recommendations.';
  }
}

class _RoomInsightCard extends StatelessWidget {
  const _RoomInsightCard({
    required this.roomName,
    required this.totalPops,
    required this.totalValue,
    required this.wishlistCount,
    required this.missingValueCount,
  });

  final String roomName;
  final int totalPops;
  final double totalValue;
  final int wishlistCount;
  final int missingValueCount;

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) {
    return AtlasGlassCard(
      accentColor: AtlasColors.vaultGold,
      child: Column(
        crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.start,
        children: [
          const AtlasSectionHeader(
            title: 'Atlas Room Insight',
            subtitle:
            'Collector guidance based on the current room snapshot.',
            icon: Icons.insights_rounded,
            accentColor: AtlasColors.vaultGold,
          ),
          const SizedBox(
            height: AtlasSpacing.md,
          ),
          AtlasInfoBanner(
            icon: Icons.auto_awesome_rounded,
            title: 'Room Analysis',
            message: _insight,
          ),
        ],
      ),
    );
  }

  String get _insight {
    if (totalPops == 0) {
      return '$roomName is ready. Add matching Pops to unlock room '
          'insights, value tracking, and wishlist recommendations.';
    }

    if (missingValueCount > 0) {
      return '$roomName has $missingValueCount '
          'Pop${missingValueCount == 1 ? '' : 's'} missing values. '
          'Updating those will improve Atlas accuracy for this room.';
    }

    if (wishlistCount > 0) {
      return '$roomName has $wishlistCount wishlist '
          'target${wishlistCount == 1 ? '' : 's'}. Atlas can use this '
          'room to help prioritize future pickups.';
    }

    if (totalValue >= 500) {
      return '$roomName is becoming one of your stronger value rooms '
          'with an estimated value of '
          '\$${totalValue.toStringAsFixed(0)}.';
    }

    return '$roomName is connected to your vault. Atlas will continue '
        'learning from this room as you add more Pops.';
  }
}

import 'package:flutter/material.dart';
import 'package:provider/provider.dart';

import '../../services/app_state.dart';
import '../../theme/atlas_colors.dart';
import '../../theme/atlas_spacing.dart';
import '../../theme/atlas_typography.dart';
import '../../widgets/atlas/atlas_glass_card.dart';
import '../../widgets/atlas/components/atlas_info_banner.dart';
import '../../widgets/atlas/components/atlas_section_header.dart';
import '../../widgets/atlas/components/atlas_status_chip.dart';
import '../../widgets/vault/vault_scroll_view.dart';
import 'atlas_room_screen.dart';

class CollectionsScreen extends StatelessWidget {
  const CollectionsScreen({super.key});

  Future<void> _showCreateCollectionDialog(
    BuildContext context,
    AppState appState,
  ) async {
    var enteredName = '';
    final name = await showDialog<String>(
      context: context,
      builder: (dialogContext) {
        return AlertDialog(
          title: const Text('Create Collection'),
          content: TextFormField(
            autofocus: true,
            decoration: const InputDecoration(
              labelText: 'Collection Name',
              border: OutlineInputBorder(),
            ),
            onChanged: (value) {
              enteredName = value;
            },
            onFieldSubmitted: (value) {
              Navigator.pop(dialogContext, value);
            },
          ),
          actions: [
            TextButton(
              onPressed: () => Navigator.pop(dialogContext),
              child: const Text('Cancel'),
            ),
            FilledButton(
              onPressed: () {
                Navigator.pop(dialogContext, enteredName);
              },
              child: const Text('Create'),
            ),
          ],
        );
      },
    );

    if (name == null || !context.mounted) {
      return;
    }

    final result = await appState.addCollection(name);

    if (!context.mounted) {
      return;
    }

    _showOperationResult(
      context,
      result,
      successMessage: 'Collection created.',
    );
  }

  Future<void> _showRenameCollectionDialog(
    BuildContext context,
    AppState appState,
    String collectionName,
  ) async {
    var enteredName = collectionName;
    final newName = await showDialog<String>(
      context: context,
      builder: (dialogContext) {
        return AlertDialog(
          title: const Text('Rename Collection'),
          content: TextFormField(
            initialValue: collectionName,
            autofocus: true,
            decoration: const InputDecoration(
              labelText: 'Collection Name',
              border: OutlineInputBorder(),
            ),
            onChanged: (value) {
              enteredName = value;
            },
            onFieldSubmitted: (value) {
              Navigator.pop(dialogContext, value);
            },
          ),
          actions: [
            TextButton(
              onPressed: () => Navigator.pop(dialogContext),
              child: const Text('Cancel'),
            ),
            FilledButton(
              onPressed: () {
                Navigator.pop(dialogContext, enteredName);
              },
              child: const Text('Rename'),
            ),
          ],
        );
      },
    );

    if (newName == null || !context.mounted) {
      return;
    }

    final result = await appState.renameCollection(collectionName, newName);

    if (!context.mounted) {
      return;
    }

    _showOperationResult(
      context,
      result,
      successMessage: 'Collection renamed.',
    );
  }

  Future<void> _showDeleteCollectionDialog(
    BuildContext context,
    AppState appState,
    String collectionName,
  ) async {
    final popCount = appState.collectionPopCount(collectionName);
    final collectionValue = appState.collectionValue(collectionName);
    final confirmed = await showDialog<bool>(
      context: context,
      builder: (dialogContext) {
        return AlertDialog(
          title: const Text('Delete Collection'),
          content: Text(
            'Delete "$collectionName"?\n\n'
            '$popCount ${popCount == 1 ? 'Pop' : 'Pops'} â€¢ '
            '\$${collectionValue.toStringAsFixed(2)} current value\n\n'
            'All Pops and wishlist tracking in this collection will be '
            'removed. This cannot be undone.',
          ),
          actions: [
            TextButton(
              onPressed: () => Navigator.pop(dialogContext, false),
              child: const Text('Cancel'),
            ),
            FilledButton.icon(
              onPressed: () => Navigator.pop(dialogContext, true),
              icon: const Icon(Icons.delete_outline_rounded),
              label: const Text('Delete'),
            ),
          ],
        );
      },
    );

    if (confirmed != true || !context.mounted) {
      return;
    }

    final result = await appState.deleteCollection(collectionName);

    if (!context.mounted) {
      return;
    }

    _showOperationResult(
      context,
      result,
      successMessage: 'Collection deleted.',
    );
  }

  Future<void> _selectCollection(
    BuildContext context,
    AppState appState,
    String collectionName,
  ) async {
    final result = await appState.setSelectedCollection(collectionName);

    if (!context.mounted || result == CollectionOperationResult.success) {
      return;
    }

    _showOperationResult(context, result);
  }

  Future<void> _openCollection(
      BuildContext context,
      AppState appState,
      String collectionName,
      ) async {
    final result = await appState.setSelectedCollection(collectionName);

    if (!context.mounted) {
      return;
    }

    if (result != CollectionOperationResult.success) {
      _showOperationResult(context, result);
      return;
    }

    await Navigator.push<void>(
      context,
      MaterialPageRoute<void>(
        builder: (_) => AtlasRoomScreen(
          roomName: collectionName,
          description:
          'Your collection room for stats, insights, previews, and collection tools.',
          icon: Icons.folder_outlined,
          collectionName: collectionName,
        ),
      ),
    );
  }

  void _showOperationResult(
    BuildContext context,
    CollectionOperationResult result, {
    String? successMessage,
  }) {
    final message = switch (result) {
      CollectionOperationResult.success => successMessage,
      CollectionOperationResult.invalidName =>
        'Enter a collection name before continuing.',
      CollectionOperationResult.duplicateName =>
        'A collection with that name already exists.',
      CollectionOperationResult.notFound =>
        'That collection is no longer available.',
      CollectionOperationResult.lastCollection =>
        'At least one collection must remain.',
      CollectionOperationResult.persistenceFailure =>
        'Atlas could not save that collection change. Please try again.',
    };

    if (message == null) {
      return;
    }

    ScaffoldMessenger.of(context)
      ..hideCurrentSnackBar()
      ..showSnackBar(SnackBar(content: Text(message)));
  }

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) {
    final appState = context.watch<AppState>();

    return Scaffold(
      appBar: AppBar(title: const Text('Collections')),
      body: VaultScrollView(
        children: [
          AtlasGlassCard(
            accentColor: AtlasColors.vaultGold,
            child: Column(
              crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.start,
              children: [
                const AtlasSectionHeader(
                  title: 'Manage Collections',
                  subtitle:
                      'Create, organize, and open the collections inside your Vault.',
                  icon: Icons.folder_copy_outlined,
                  accentColor: AtlasColors.vaultGold,
                ),
                const SizedBox(height: AtlasSpacing.lg),
                DropdownButtonFormField<String>(
                  key: ValueKey(appState.selectedCollection),
                  initialValue: appState.selectedCollection,
                  decoration: const InputDecoration(
                    labelText: 'Active Collection',
                    border: OutlineInputBorder(),
                  ),
                  items: appState.collectionNames.map((name) {
                    return DropdownMenuItem<String>(
                      value: name,
                      child: Text(name),
                    );
                  }).toList(),
                  onChanged: (value) {
                    if (value != null) {
                      _selectCollection(context, appState, value);
                    }
                  },
                ),
              ],
            ),
          ),
          const SizedBox(height: AtlasSpacing.lg),
          const AtlasInfoBanner(
            icon: Icons.info_outline_rounded,
            title: 'Entire Vault Stays Global',
            message:
                'Opening a collection shows only that collection. The main Vault and Entire Vault continue to include every collection.',
          ),
          const SizedBox(height: AtlasSpacing.lg),
          LayoutBuilder(
            builder: (context, constraints) {
              final isWide = constraints.maxWidth >= 900;
              final crossAxisCount = isWide ? 3 : 2;

              return GridView.builder(
                key: const ValueKey('collections-grid'),
                shrinkWrap: true,
                physics: const NeverScrollableScrollPhysics(),
                itemCount: appState.collectionNames.length,
                gridDelegate: SliverGridDelegateWithFixedCrossAxisCount(
                  crossAxisCount: crossAxisCount,
                  crossAxisSpacing: AtlasSpacing.md,
                  mainAxisSpacing: AtlasSpacing.md,
                  childAspectRatio: isWide ? 1.15 : 0.80,
                ),
                itemBuilder: (context, index) {
                  final collectionName = appState.collectionNames[index];
                  final popCount = appState.collectionPopCount(collectionName);
                  final collectionValue = appState.collectionValue(collectionName);
                  final isActive = collectionName == appState.selectedCollection;

                  return _CollectionGridCard(
                    collectionName: collectionName,
                    popCount: popCount,
                    collectionValue: collectionValue,
                    isActive: isActive,
                    onOpen: () {
                      _openCollection(
                        context,
                        appState,
                        collectionName,
                      );
                    },
                    onRename: () {
                      _showRenameCollectionDialog(
                        context,
                        appState,
                        collectionName,
                      );
                    },
                    onDelete: () {
                      _showDeleteCollectionDialog(
                        context,
                        appState,
                        collectionName,
                      );
                    },
                  );
                },
              );
            },
          ),
          const SizedBox(height: AtlasSpacing.sm),
          FilledButton.icon(
            onPressed: () {
              _showCreateCollectionDialog(context, appState);
            },
            icon: const Icon(Icons.create_new_folder_outlined),
            label: const Text('Create Collection'),
          ),
        ],
      ),
    );
  }
}

class _CollectionGridCard extends StatelessWidget {
  const _CollectionGridCard({
    required this.collectionName,
    required this.popCount,
    required this.collectionValue,
    required this.isActive,
    required this.onOpen,
    required this.onRename,
    required this.onDelete,
  });

  final String collectionName;
  final int popCount;
  final double collectionValue;
  final bool isActive;
  final VoidCallback onOpen;
  final VoidCallback onRename;
  final VoidCallback onDelete;

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) {
    final accentColor =
    isActive ? AtlasColors.success : AtlasColors.vaultGold;

    return AtlasGlassCard(
      onTap: onOpen,
      accentColor: accentColor,
      borderRadius: 22,
      padding: const EdgeInsets.all(AtlasSpacing.md),
      child: Column(
        crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.start,
        children: [
          Row(
            crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.start,
            children: [
              Icon(
                Icons.folder_outlined,
                color: accentColor,
                size: 30,
              ),
              const Spacer(),
              if (isActive)
                const AtlasStatusChip(
                  label: 'Active',
                  icon: Icons.check_circle_outline_rounded,
                  accentColor: AtlasColors.success,
                  size: AtlasStatusChipSize.compact,
                ),
              PopupMenuButton<_CollectionAction>(
                key: ValueKey('actions-$collectionName'),
                tooltip: 'Collection actions',
                onSelected: (action) {
                  switch (action) {
                    case _CollectionAction.rename:
                      onRename();
                    case _CollectionAction.delete:
                      onDelete();
                  }
                },
                itemBuilder: (_) => const [
                  PopupMenuItem(
                    value: _CollectionAction.rename,
                    child: Text('Rename'),
                  ),
                  PopupMenuItem(
                    value: _CollectionAction.delete,
                    child: Text('Delete'),
                  ),
                ],
              ),
            ],
          ),
          const SizedBox(height: AtlasSpacing.md),
          Text(
            collectionName,
            maxLines: 2,
            overflow: TextOverflow.ellipsis,
            style: AtlasTypography.bodyMedium.copyWith(
              fontWeight: FontWeight.bold,
            ),
          ),
          const SizedBox(height: AtlasSpacing.xs),
          Text(
            '$popCount ${popCount == 1 ? 'Pop' : 'Pops'}',
            style: AtlasTypography.bodySmall.copyWith(
              color: AtlasColors.textSecondary,
            ),
          ),
          const SizedBox(height: AtlasSpacing.xs),
          Text(
            '\$${collectionValue.toStringAsFixed(2)}',
            style: AtlasTypography.bodyMedium.copyWith(
              color: accentColor,
              fontWeight: FontWeight.w600,
            ),
          ),
          const Spacer(),
          SizedBox(
            width: double.infinity,
            child: OutlinedButton.icon(
              key: ValueKey('open-$collectionName'),
              onPressed: onOpen,
              icon: const Icon(Icons.visibility_outlined),
              label: const Text('Open Collection'),
            ),
          ),
        ],
      ),
    );
  }
}
